# AI Spend Doctor

> Free, browser-only check of Claude (Anthropic) and OpenAI API usage and cost CSV exports. The file is read on the user's device and never uploaded: the page's Content Security Policy sets connect-src 'none', and the check works offline. No signup, no API key, no analytics.

What it shows from a usage or cost CSV:
- Daily spend spikes (a day over 3x the median day of the file)
- Share of input tokens read from the prompt cache, when the export has cache data
- Share of spend at Batch or Flex prices, when the export has a tier or batch column
- Share of spend on top-tier models
- Price scenarios for older Claude models at the current same-tier model's list prices, including about 30% more tokens on Claude's newer tokenizer (estimates, not confirmed savings)

Checks that need data the export lacks are marked "not available", never shown as 0%. Unknown models are never given a guessed price. Reported costs and token-based estimates are kept separate.
